new_today_news.headline: Pertamina Turns Used Cooking Oil Into Sustainable Jet Fuel
new_today_news.summary: PT Pertamina Patra Niaga is expanding Indonesia's sustainable energy supply by converting used cooking oil into sustainable aviation fuel at its Cilacap Green Refinery, achieving commercial production stage with approximately 11 million liters of co-processed SAF in October 2026.

new_today_news.headline: Stanwood Grill Closes After 25 Years, Family Bets It All on Max Dale's
new_today_news.summary: A 25-year-old restaurant in Stanwood, Washington closes as operating costs soar in the region. The family is consolidating operations by folding Stanwood Grill into Max Dale's, reflecting broader restaurant industry consolidation trends.

new_today_news.headline: Biofuels Partners and Jianglan Bio-Energy strengthen collaboration to advance renewable fuel supply chains
new_today_news.summary: Biofuels Partners has signed a collaboration agreement with Jianglan Bio-Energy to expand international cooperation across used cooking oil (UCO), hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO), and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF). The partnership emphasizes transparent sourcing and verified sustainability.

new_today_news.headline: The Grease Hunters of Bengaluru Want Leftover Fryer Oil to Fuel India's Jets
new_today_news.summary: India's biofuel mandate is driving demand for used cooking oil from restaurants. Collectors traverse cities gathering fryer oil from kitchens as refiners compete for UCO feedstock to meet renewable fuel requirements.

new_today_news.headline: 'Tremendous leap forward': Libertyville upgrading wastewater treatment plant
new_today_news.summary: Libertyville awarded a $3.28 million contract to upgrade its wastewater treatment plant, converting the disinfection process from liquid chlorine to ultraviolet light and replacing pumps and nondrinking water systems.

recent_news.headline: Taco Bell extends PepsiCo partnership through 2036
recent_news.summary: Taco Bell has extended its partnership with PepsiCo through 2036, with a focus on crafted, functional, and energy beverages. This reflects continued beverage innovation in the QSR sector.

recent_news.headline: Chinese UCO exports rise by 55%
recent_news.summary: Chinese used cooking oil exports rose 55% in January-August 2026 compared to the same period in 2025, reaching 2.57 million tonnes. The USA imported 452,000 tonnes, making it the second-largest buyer after Europe.

recent_news.headline: Spring Restaurant Ditches Its Last Server for an AI Host Named Haniya
recent_news.summary: A restaurant in Texas eliminates its last human server by deploying an AI host, with kitchen staff receiving 100% of customer tips. The trend reflects 26% of restaurant operators using some form of AI tools.

backfill_news.headline: [Date unverified] Clean Harbors to Report Q3 2026 Earnings Before Market Open
backfill_news.summary: Clean Harbors (NYSE: CLH) is scheduled to report Q3 2026 results on October 28, 2026 before market open. Analysts expect EPS of $3.21–$3.23 and revenue of $1.72–$1.73 billion, with expected YoY revenue growth of 11.3–11.4%. The company has beaten EPS estimates in 6 of last 8 quarters.
